description: Source code for FreeType PFR glyph loader, including glyph initialization, contour management, and glyph data parsing functions.

methods.name: pfr_glyph_close_contour
methods.description: Closes the current contour in a glyph, removing duplicate points if necessary.

methods.name: pfr_glyph_start
methods.description: Resets glyph to start loading a new glyph.

methods.name: pfr_glyph_line_to
methods.description: Adds a line segment to the glyph outline.

methods.name: pfr_glyph_curve_to
methods.description: Adds a cubic Bézier curve to the glyph outline.

methods.name: pfr_glyph_move_to
methods.description: Starts a new contour at a specified point.

methods.name: pfr_glyph_end
methods.description: Finalizes the current glyph contour and merges it into the glyph loader.

methods.name: pfr_glyph_load_simple
methods.description: Loads a simple glyph from data.

methods.name: pfr_glyph_load_compound
methods.description: Loads a compound glyph composed of sub-glyphs.

methods.name: pfr_glyph_load_rec
methods.description: Recursively loads a glyph, handling simple and compound types.

methods.name: pfr_glyph_load
methods.description: Initializes glyph loader and loads glyph data recursively.
